name: FIFA 11+ Warm-up (Part 1 Running Drills)
cues: Easy jog pace, building gradually
Hip, knee and foot stay in a straight line
Land softly on the balls of your feet

video.title: FIFA 11+ Complete Warm-up Program - Part I - Running Exercises

backup.title: FIFA 11+ Part 1: Warm-Up

notes: Primary walks through the FIFA 11+ Part I running exercises in one clip from a university sports-medicine program. FIFA's own channel appears to post one video per exercise (its 'Part 1' clip shows only straight-ahead running, and the series runs to 'Part 11a'), so a complete Part I walkthrough was preferred.

name: Snap-Downs
cues: Start tall on your toes, arms overhead
Snap arms down and drop hips back into an athletic stance
Land quiet and freeze, knees over toes

video.title: How to Perform a Snap Down for Landing Mechanics

backup.title: Introduction to Landings: Snap Downs

notes: Backup is demonstrated by a female physio and also shows a split-stance variation at the end.

name: Step Off Box and Stick Landing
cues: Step off a low box or step, don't jump off
Land on both feet at the same time, soft and quiet
Hold 2 seconds: knees over toes, chest up

video.title: Double Leg Drop Landing

backup.title: Drop Landing

notes: Primary is filmed from the front, which shows knee alignment best; backup is a side view. Use a low box or step only.

name: Volleyball Approach Footwork (3- and 4-Step)
cues: Start slow, finish fast: each step quicker than the last
Long second-to-last step, then close the feet quickly
Swing both arms back on the last step

video.title: Develop Your Footwork for a Stronger Attack!

backup.title: How to Four Step Approach in Volleyball

notes: Primary: University of Louisville head coach Anne Kordes teaching attack footwork to a line of young female players, no ball needed. Backup covers the 4-step approach specifically. Parent check: confirm both 3- and 4-step patterns are shown well enough.

name: Approach Jump with Arm Swing
cues: Both arms swing back on the last two steps
Plant and jump straight up, not forward
Land on two feet, knees bent and balanced

video.title: The Approach

backup.title: Approach Jump Technique - How to Perform a Volleyball Approach Jump

notes: Primary is a short side-view breakdown of the full approach and arm swing. Backup is 5:25 long; frames sampled across it all show demonstration, and no timestamp could be confirmed, so it starts at 0.

name: Squat Jump
cues: Sit back to a quarter squat, arms back
Jump straight up and reach high
Stick the landing: soft knees over toes, hold 2 seconds

video.title: Stability: Double Leg Squat Jump & Stick

backup.title: Exercises with an Athletic Trainer: Double Leg Jumps with Eccentric Landing

notes: Primary shows a female athlete performing the jump-and-stick from the front. Backup (Children's Hospital Colorado) is the same jump with a controlled landing.

name: Pogo Hops
cues: Small, quick hops off the balls of your feet
Knees nearly straight, bounce from the ankles
Stay tall and quiet; stop if form breaks

video.title: Double-Leg Pogo Hops in Place | Ankle & Plyometric Exercise

backup.title: Pogo Jumps Tutorial - Proper Form and Technique

notes: Primary is from a physical-therapy clinic. Backup shows a female demonstrator.

name: Lateral Bound with Stick
cues: Push sideways off the outside leg
Land on the other foot and stick for 2 seconds
Knee stays over toes, never caving in

video.title: Lateral Bound w/ Stick (Speed Skater)

backup.title: Skater Bound with Stick Landing | X3 Performance

notes: Backup has on-screen cues ('load the outside hip, push laterally, stick, sink and hold').

name: Bodyweight Squat
cues: Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out
Sit hips back and down, knees track over toes
Chest up, push through the whole foot to stand

name: Goblet Squat
cues: Hold the light dumbbell at your chest, elbows in
Sit down between your heels, knees out over toes
Chest tall, stand up through the mid-foot

backup.title: How to do a Goblet Squat // Form & Setup!

name: Split Squat
cues: Front knee over toes
Back knee drops straight down
Tall chest

name: Rear-Foot Elevated Split Squat
cues: Back foot laces-down on a low box or step
Lower straight down until the front thigh is about level
Front knee tracks over toes; push through the front heel

name: Glute Bridge
cues: Feet flat and hip-width, knees bent
Squeeze glutes and lift until shoulders, hips and knees line up
Don't arch the low back; lower slowly

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
cues: One foot planted, other leg lifted straight
Push through the planted heel and keep hips level
Lower slowly, then switch legs

Straight line from head to heels
Squeeze glutes, brace abs and keep breathing

Lift hips so head, hips and feet form one line

Shuffle without crossing your feet
Stop, set your platform and angle it to the target
